task: What is the difference between data drift and concept drift?
final_answer: Data drift is a change in the distribution of the input features — the model's mapping is still correct but the inputs have shifted. Concept drift is a change in the relationship between inputs and outputs — the same input features now correspond to different labels. Practical difference: data drift can be detected without labels by comparing input distributions, while concept drift requires ground-truth labels and is therefore harder to detect in real time.
